description: This little mod adds some various custom made ships to the game, they are:
descriptionHtml: This little mod adds some various custom made ships to the game, they are:
aiDescription: Introduces new vessels such as the Ark Royal, a powerful heavy capital ship equipped with assault chainguns and LRM launchers. The ship lacks shields and point defense, making it vulnerable to carriers and bombers.
